lines.speaker: KESTREL
lines.direction: controlled insertion briefing; professional, low urgency
lines.text: Seven, Meridian Control missed two scheduled check-ins.

lines.speaker: KESTREL
lines.text: Forty-two evacuees never reached orbit. Mira Sen is still missing.

lines.speaker: KESTREL
lines.text: Mira's last burst: 'Northstar offline. Array waking.' Then a Warden transponder crossed Gate Zero-Seven.

lines.speaker: KESTREL
lines.text: Restore Northstar. Recover the manifest. Find our people.

lines.speaker: KESTREL
lines.text: You are down. I will hold above the shelf until you call.

lines.speaker: KESTREL
lines.text: Camp Twelve. No movement. The evacuation board is still powered.

lines.speaker: KESTREL
lines.text: Gate Zero-Seven. Warden barricades. Somebody wanted the colony sealed in.

lines.speaker: KESTREL
lines.text: Northstar is intact. Bring it online and let us hear what Meridian tried to send.

lines.speaker: MIRA SEN
lines.direction: damaged emergency transmission; exhausted but urgent
lines.text: Seven... Shelter Twelve. We are below the array. Do not let them fire.

lines.speaker: KESTREL
lines.text: Copy. AEGIS is targeting the shelter. Get to the core.

lines.speaker: MIRA SEN
lines.direction: scientist confronting the impossible; fearful restraint
lines.text: It is not a foundation. The black ribs continue below the old waterline. It answers the calibration tone.

lines.speaker: KESTREL
lines.direction: cuts through the mystery; rescue first
lines.text: Whatever it is, save the people first. Kill the firing order.

lines.speaker: KESTREL
lines.text: Strike canceled. West service road back to LZ Zero-Seven. I am coming in.

lines.speaker: KESTREL
lines.text: Sixty seconds. Keep the pad clear. I need one clean approach.

lines.speaker: SUIT
lines.text: Reinforcement movement on both service roads. Multiple contacts converging.

lines.speaker: KESTREL
lines.text: Visual on the pad. Final approach. Keep your head down.

lines.speaker: KESTREL
lines.text: Gear down. Six seconds.

lines.speaker: KESTREL
lines.text: Kestrel is down. Clear the pad and get aboard.

lines.speaker: KESTREL
lines.text: Seven, you are on. Strap in.

lines.speaker: KESTREL
lines.direction: liftoff; controlled relief with unresolved tension
lines.text: Lifting. Shelter Twelve is alive. Mira is still transmitting.

lines.speaker: M-17 PILOT
lines.direction: recorded cockpit distress; clipped, under stress
lines.text: Colony filters. Medical packs. Security ammunition. Landing clearance revoked. Gate Zero-Seven will not answer. Putting her down in the tide channel.
